title: Historical Rorschach plates — exploratory visual descriptions
source: Hermann Rorschach (1921). Ten unnormalized JPEG reproductions from Wikimedia Commons, Rorschach blot 01.jpg through Rorschach blot 10.jpg. See assets/rorschach/manifest.json for source revisions, public-domain metadata and checksums. These digital reproductions are not certified clinical stimulus materials.
limitations: Exploratory image description only, not a standardized clinical Rorschach administration or validated personality assessment. Famous plates and common interpretations may occur in training data; responses cannot distinguish visual perception from memorized associations. Each plate is presented independently, without a clinical inquiry phase.
instruction: Describe the image. Distinguish visible shapes from possible interpretations. There is no single correct interpretation.
